    View before you download.

    Search every major index at once and open the result right here — films, TV, music and images. Nothing to install, nothing to queue, and nothing stored on our servers.

    1 · Search or paste

    One query fans out across every configured indexer. Results are grouped by title, so one film is one poster with a quality picker — not forty near-identical rows.

    2 · Press play

    Your browser joins the swarm and starts at the first byte it needs, so playback begins long before the file is complete.

    3 · It plays on your machine

    Pieces are verified and decoded on your own device. We never transcode, never cache, and never keep a copy.

    Get the app

    Tester builds, straight from GitHub. Store versions are on the way — until then these install directly.

    Sources

    Settings

    Theme

    Applied before the page is drawn, so switching costs no flash of the other one. The player and the page reader stay dark in every theme on purpose — a bright surround changes how the picture inside it looks, which is why cinemas are painted black.

    Cover size

    How big the artwork is, in the search grid and in every discover row. Large is for a television across a room; small fits more of the catalogue on screen at once.

    Motion

    Picture

    Nostalgia TV and most of archive.org is 320×240 to 496×368 — old television, at the size it was broadcast. Filling scales it up to a whole-number multiple and asks for crisp edges rather than a smeared one; it never crops, and it never touches a source that is already large.

    Behaviour

    Game player

    Which player an archive.org game starts in, when both can run it. You can still switch mid-game from the bar above the picture.

    Language

    Music results are filtered to English unless you say otherwise — that is the server's default, and this is where it is stated rather than implied. An item that says nothing about its language is always kept: most of the Live Music Archive never filled the field in. This also picks which subtitle track comes up first.

    Results

    Saved filters

    Sort order, minimum seeders, size, quality and codec are remembered per category, because "at least 40 seeders" is a sentence about a swarm and means nothing about an archive.org concert. This is everything this browser is currently holding.

    Server

    Leave this blank to use whichever server delivered this page — which is why a copy you host yourself needs no setting up at all.

    Add-ons

    Yarr.It speaks the Stremio add-on protocol, so add-ons written for Stremio work here — in a browser, with nothing to install. Paste an add-on's manifest URL.

    Your services

    Connect the Radarr, Jellyfin, Plex, Komga or RomM you run yourself. No account, ever — this list lives in this browser and nowhere else, so a machine you have never signed in on still reaches your own setup.

    A key or token you type here is saved in this browser's own storage and sent only to the address you gave. It is never sent to yarrit.com, and it is never written into a link.

    Yours to choose. Two Radarrs are normal — call one "Radarr 4K".

    Account

    Optional. Everything else in here works signed out and always will — this is only for a shelf that follows you between devices, and for pairing a TV.
